title: OpenZIM Binary Container
paragraphs: OpenZIM is an open binary file specification maintained for storing offline wiki and reference content in a single random-access archive.
Every compliant ZIM archive begins at byte offset zero with the 32-bit little-endian magic integer 72173914, which corresponds to hexadecimal 0x044D495A.

Article payloads are grouped into compressed clusters using LZMA2, Zstandard, zlib, or uncompressed byte blobs so readers can seek individual articles via 64-bit pointer tables without unpacking the entire archive.

title: SQLite FTS5 Inverted Index
paragraphs: FTS5 is a virtual table module built into SQLite that provides full-text inverted indexing and Okapi BM25 ranking inside a single local database file.
During BM25 scoring, FTS5 weights term frequency saturation and inverse document frequency across configurable column weights such as article title and paragraph body.
Writing documents in bounded transaction batches keeps Python heap usage flat while indexing hundreds of thousands of reference paragraphs on 16 GB laptops.

title: SimHash Locality-Sensitive Hashing
paragraphs: Introduced by Moses Charikar, SimHash projects weighted lexical or character n-gram features into a compact 64-bit binary signature.
Unlike cryptographic hashes such as SHA-256 that avalanche on a single character edit, two passages with minor spelling typos produce SimHash integers separated by a small Hamming distance.
Combining BM25 lexical recall with character trigram Jaccard similarity and 64-bit SimHash reranking recovers relevant paragraphs without loading multi-gigabyte neural embedding weights.

title: Quartz Piezoelectric Oscillator
paragraphs: Jacques and Pierre Curie demonstrated piezoelectricity in 1880 when mechanical stress applied to crystalline quartz generated a measurable surface electric charge.

Standard wristwatches cut a miniature quartz tuning fork to vibrate at 32768 hertz, chosen because 32768 equals two raised to the fifteenth power and divides cleanly down to a one-hertz pulse via fifteen flip-flop stages.
Temperature-compensated crystal oscillators stabilize resonant drift across industrial operating ranges within parts per million.

title: Core Rope Read-Only Memory
paragraphs: The Apollo Guidance Computer stored flight software inside non-volatile core rope memory woven through ferrite transformer rings.
Passing a sense wire through the center of a magnetic core encoded a binary one, whereas routing the wire around the exterior of the core encoded a binary zero.
Core rope modules achieved roughly 72 kilobytes of radiation-tolerant storage inside the Block II guidance computer while surviving power interruptions without state loss.

title: Svalbard Global Seed Vault
paragraphs: Carved 120 meters inside a sandstone mountain on Spitsbergen island in Norway, the Svalbard Global Seed Vault preserves duplicate crop seed accessions from gene banks worldwide.
Mechanical refrigeration cools the surrounding permafrost chambers to minus 18 degrees Celsius, slowing metabolic aging inside three-ply foil seed packets.
Surrounding permafrost and elevated bedrock above sea level provide passive thermal buffering for weeks if external electrical power is interrupted.

title: Submarine Optical Fiber Cables
paragraphs: Modern transoceanic telecommunications cables carry dense wavelength-division multiplexed laser signals through silica glass fibers thinner than a human hair.

Instead of converting optical pulses back to electrical signals at sea, erbium-doped fiber amplifiers spaced roughly every 60 to 100 kilometers boost 1550-nanometer light directly in the optical domain.
High-voltage direct-current copper conductors inside the cable sheath power the submerged optical repeaters from shore landing stations.

title: Binary Cycle Geothermal Power
paragraphs: Binary cycle geothermal plants generate electricity from moderate-temperature hydrothermal reservoirs between 100 and 180 degrees Celsius.
Geothermal brine passes through a closed heat exchanger to vaporize a secondary organic working fluid such as isobutane or pentane that boils at a lower temperature than water.

Because the geothermal brine is reinjected into the reservoir inside a closed loop without flashing to the atmosphere, binary plants maintain reservoir pressure and emit minimal non-condensable gases.
